title: Does GTA 6 Have Darts? No, and Rockstar Explains Why (Pool Is In)
desc: GTA 6 has no darts or bowling. Rockstar North's Rob Nelson told VGC why: "even we do not" have unlimited time or money. Pool made it in. Sources inside, no spoilers.
lede: Short answer: no. GTA 6 has no darts and no bowling, two minigames GTA fans remember from earlier games. Pool is in. Rockstar North's co-studio head Rob Nelson explained the cut in an interview with Video Games Chronicle on launch day (Nov 19, 2026). No story spoilers.
sections:
"The darts one is a contentious one," Nelson told VGC. "Even we... you hear they have unlimited money or unlimited time, even we do not and so sometimes you just have to admit we are not going to be able to make this to the level we feel we need to."

In other words: Rockstar would rather leave a minigame out than ship one it isn't happy with. GGRecon's report of the same interview says bowling was cut for the same reason.

Pool is an activity in GTA 6: you can play it in bars and recreational venues, and it counts toward 100% completion (GTABase). In the interview, Nelson named pool, weightlifting and basketball as interactions the team felt it could make feel authentic (as reported by GGRecon).
Rockstar hasn't said. Nelson gave no promise that darts or bowling will come back in an update, so treat any claim that they're "coming soon" as a rumor until Rockstar says so.
note: We'll update this page if Rockstar adds darts or bowling in an update.
faq: No. Rockstar North's Rob Nelson told VGC on Nov 19, 2026 that darts didn't make it because the team couldn't make it as good as it wanted in the time it had.
No. Bowling was also cut, according to reports of the same interview (GGRecon, GameNewsPlus).
Can you play pool in GTA 6?
Yes. Pool is an activity in bars and recreational venues and is part of 100% completion.
